summary: Iteration 3 – Regression pass after CORS_ORIGINS was moved from hardcoded '*' to env-driven config in server.py. 10/10 backend pytest tests pass in 4.60s. All previously-verified endpoints still green (GET /api/ Hello World, GET /api/status list, POST /api/status persist + 422 validation, POST /api/analyze-motion happy path + data-URI variant + empty-body 422 + empty-string 400 with a real 256x256 JPEG through Claude Sonnet 5). Two NEW CORS tests added and pass: OPTIONS preflight from foreign origin returns 200 with Access-Control-Allow-Origin=* and Access-Control-Allow-Methods including POST; real GET with Origin header echoes Allow-Origin=*. No 500s, no import errors, no regressions. CORS env-driven change is deployment-safe.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:188 – `allow_origins` correctly parses CORS_ORIGINS from env with comma-split + strip, defaulting to '*' when unset. Empty tokens filtered out via `if o.strip()` guard.

server.py:187 – `allow_credentials=True` combined with `allow_origins=['*']` is technically a browser-side no-op (browsers reject credentials with wildcard origin), but works fine for the current app which does not use cookie auth. Cosmetic only.
backend/.env:3 – CORS_ORIGINS="*" is deployment-ready; for production consider tightening to explicit origins (e.g. https://your-app.com) since the default fallback is already '*'.

server.py – `logger` still defined AFTER analyze_motion route (line 198) that references it (line 162). Currently harmless due to module-level lazy resolution, but consider moving logging setup above route definitions. Carried over from iteration_2.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_<uuid8> status doc inserted by test_status_create_and_persist (harmless, matches prior iterations).
context_for_next_testing_agent: CORS is now env-driven via backend/.env:CORS_ORIGINS (comma-separated, default '*'). To test other origin lists, set CORS_ORIGINS='https://a.com,https://b.com' and restart backend – the wildcard tests would then need to expect the specific origin echo. Suite runs against EXPO_BACKEND_URL (default https://move-sense-1.preview.emergentagent.com). Analyze-motion tests use a PIL-generated JPEG (see _make_jpeg_b64 in test_analyze_motion.py) – any solid-color / blank image would violate the image_testing.md rules.
rca_of_issue: N/A – no bugs found. CORS_ORIGINS env change is behaviourally equivalent to the previous hardcoded '*' and preserves all cross-origin functionality.
